summary: Chapter 23 — Personality Layer. Deep single-chapter documentation covering the two-stage architecture (tool result summarisation then LLM generation), the summariseToolResultsForLLM function and why each tool gets bespoke summarisation logic, product truncation to MAX_PRODUCTS_FOR_LLM, the DCO (Dynamic Context Orchestrator) and its role in replacing the monolithic prompt, intent-aware DCO config loading, all composable prompt segments and when each fires, multi-intent DCO config merging strategies, history windowing, rescue context injection on failures, skipped action messaging, the visual_search pruning rule, and the Groq LLM call with token budget and fail-safe fallback.
